title: Apply a patch set into a patched copy
summary: Check where each patch of a patch set lands in the game, then apply it into a marked patched copy. The game folder is only read.

inputs.name: copy
inputs.label: Patched copy folder (absolute; an existing copy is patched in place)

steps.title: Read the plan
steps.text: Every patch should be found once, with the bytes you expect. A patch that is not found or found twice stops here: fix the patch set first.

steps.title: Apply it into the patched copy
